Class BookFileStore

java.lang.Object
library.storage.BookFileStore
public class BookFileStore extends Object
Saves books to a CSV text file and loads them back.

Each line of the file holds one book: id,title,author,status. Fields that contain a comma or a quotation mark are wrapped in quotation marks, and a quotation mark inside a field is written twice. The status is stored by its constant name, for example ISSUED.

This class only deals with files. The rules of the library stay in LibraryService.

Author:
Naseem Ullah

    • save

      public void save(List<Book> books) throws IOException
      Writes all given books to the file, replacing its old contents.

      The data is first written to a temporary file next to the real one and then moved over it, so a crash while saving cannot leave a half-written file.

      Parameters:
      books - the books to save
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be written

    • load

      public List<Book> load() throws IOException
      Reads the books from the file.

      A missing file is not an error: it simply means nothing has been saved yet. Lines that are damaged (wrong number of fields or an unknown status) are skipped.

      Returns:
      the books in the file; an empty list if the file does not exist
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file exists but cannot be read
